visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan-and-white Corgi wearing a pink collar lies on its back in a field of tall green grass, rolling side to side and kicking its paws in the air. The ground is covered with fallen brown leaves and a few small, dark fruits. (2) The camera pans upward and to the right, showing a public park setting. A man in a black shirt is sitting on a low concrete perimeter wall with a small white dog standing beside him. In the background, a large yellow and brown wooden play structure stands under a bright, overcast sky. (3) The Corgi stands up on all fours and walks through the grass. The camera then cuts to a young child with short dark hair, wearing a pink t-shirt and light green pants, sitting on a gray gravel surface next to a colorful green and red spiral slide. The child is holding and manipulating a small blue and yellow toy.
